{"criterion": "Contrast Brazil's view that the text met some Lebanese concerns with China's judgment that it did not adequately address them. Do not convert this into disagreement on whether UNIFIL should exist.", "sources": {"vote": "On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour.", "brazil": "Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns.", "china": "China supported UNIFIL's work but said the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns. It stressed host-State sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping and supported closer communication between UNIFIL and Lebanon's Government and military."}, "records": {"A": "China took note of the Council vote.", "B": "Brazil continued to support UNIFIL."}}

{"criterion": "State that Brazil and China both supported UNIFIL's continued work, scoped to the mission rather than agreement on the text.", "sources": {"vote": "On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour.", "brazil": "Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns.", "china": "China supported UNIFIL's work but said the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns. It stressed host-State sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping and supported closer communication between UNIFIL and Lebanon's Government and military."}, "records": {"A": "Brazil and China both supported UNIFIL's work. Brazil saw the text as addressing some Lebanese concerns. China judged that they were insufficiently addressed.", "B": "Brazil and China both backed the resolution as adopted."}}

{"criterion": "Record that UNIFIL may act independently within its mandate without prior permission.", "sources": {"operative": "Operative paragraph 1 extended UNIFIL's existing mandate until 31 August 2024. Paragraph 15 reaffirmed its independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission and its continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement."}, "records": {"A": "On 31 August 2023, the Security Council voted on France's draft S/2023/641. It adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes to none, with China and Russia abstaining. The existing UNIFIL mandate was extended until 31 August 2024. The resolution reaffirmed UNIFIL's independence in carrying out mandated tasks only with Lebanon's prior permission, while preserving coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement.", "B": "On 31 August 2023, the Security Council voted on France's draft S/2023/641. It adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes to none, with China and Russia abstaining. The existing UNIFIL mandate was extended until 31 August 2024. The resolution reaffirmed UNIFIL's independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission, while preserving coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement."}}
